competitors.name: Trader Joe's
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported that Trader Joe's has the highest loyalty among U.S. grocers despite having no loyalty program, relying instead on private-label products, service and everyday low prices. The article noted that more than 80% of Trader Joe's products were private label as of early 2023.

competitors.name: Loblaw / T&T Supermarket
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Loblaw's first California T&T Supermarket, opened in San Jose in June, set the highest first-week sales record for any Loblaw store. Loblaw plans two more California T&T locations this year and said discount banners outperformed overall grocery in Q2.

competitors.name: FMI / beverage CPG retailers
competitors.action: Supermarket News covered FMI's inaugural Power of Beverage 2026 report, which found shoppers spent nearly $295 billion on retail beverages in 2025 and are increasingly buying around functions such as hydration, energy, protein, digestive health and mood support rather than only traditional beverage categories.

trends.topic: Retail differentiation is leaning on proprietary assortment and occasion-based merchandising
trends.context: Trader Joe's loyalty model, T&T's California launch performance and FMI's functional beverage findings point to shoppers responding to differentiated product sets, clear value and need-state merchandising. For premium frozen and artisan food brands, retailer fit and use occasion remain as important as single-SKU novelty.

market_data.value: More than 80% of products as of early 2023

market_data.change: Total retail sales up 4.1%; food retail sales up 3.3%; ecommerce sales up 19.3%
FMI says function is becoming a primary beverage purchase driver
